modules-for-reading-a-key-from-the-regis.text: Modules for reading a key from the registry address.
Issue 744. This page places the new and changed code and fixes its dependency direction. Records are in the data model and signatures in the functions model.

changed-components.text: Paths are proposals. When the Lean models name a component differently, the code takes the model's name, and the mandate is versioned before the slice that creates it starts.

dependency-direction.text: The Singular package names no application: the reader identifies the application by policy and script hashes from the release table, and an application that decodes its own holding hosts the reader from its own package.
